meta.name: Eleanor rehab coach - movement benchmarks

conventions.angles: degrees; clinical zero (0 = neutral/straight); flexion positive
conventions.sign_in_sources: GATES2016 extension/external rotation/supination are negative; stored here as positive magnitudes where noted

meta.disclaimer: Benchmarks adapted from published clinical instruments and normative data for a student prototype. Not a clinical assessment and not validated for this system.

FMA2026.citation: Hervé-Colas J, Newton SP, Engelter ST, et al., Alt Murphy M. Standardized international manual of the Fugl-Meyer Assessment of motor function after stroke. Neurorehabil Neural Repair. 2026. FMA-UE instruction manual, University of Gothenburg, May 2026.
FMA2026.used_for: Layer 1 item criteria (0/1/2), general scoring rules, start positions, compensation bans, time rule for coordination
FMA2026.limits: Assessment tool, not a training target; several items need an assessor's resistance, a reflex hammer or objects; webcam scores are 'FMA-style', not a clinical FMA score. Free for clinical/research use without charge; cite the publication.

SOUCIE2011.citation: Soucie JM, Wang C, Forsyth A, et al. Range of motion measurements: reference values and a database for comparison studies. Haemophilia. 2011;17:500-507.
SOUCIE2011.used_for: Layer 2a normative ROM ceilings and plausibility limits (female/male, 45-69 y)
SOUCIE2011.limits: Passive ROM with goniometer, supine for shoulder/elbow; healthy US volunteers up to 69 y (Eleanor is 72); active ROM after stroke will be lower. Left-right differences < 1 deg, supporting the healthy limb as reference.

GATES2016.citation: Gates DH, Walters LS, Cowley J, Wilken JM, Resnik L. Range of motion requirements for upper-limb activities of daily living. Am J Occup Ther. 2016;70(1):7001350010.
GATES2016.used_for: Layer 2b functional ROM milestones per daily task (drinking, shelf reach, dressing); healthy trunk-motion reference
GATES2016.limits: 15 healthy young adults (mean 26 y), right arm, 3D motion capture with globe angles; webcam 2D angles only approximate these definitions.

BAIN2015.citation: Bain GI, Polites N, Higgs BG, Heptinstall RJ, McGrath AM. The functional range of motion of the finger joints. J Hand Surg Eur Vol. 2015;40(4):406-411.
BAIN2015.used_for: Layer 2b finger ROM needed for 90% of Sollerman ADL tasks; active finger ROM ceiling
BAIN2015.limits: 10 healthy volunteers aged 18-53, dominant hand, electrogoniometer; MediaPipe finger angles are not validated against it.

LEVIN2004.citation: Levin MF, Desrosiers J, Beauchemin D, Bergeron N, Rochette A. Development and validation of a scale for rating motor compensations used for reaching in patients with hemiparesis: the Reaching Performance Scale. Phys Ther. 2004;84(1):8-22.
LEVIN2004.used_for: Layer 2c compensation rules for reaching (trunk share of reach, shoulder/elbow contribution), reach task setup
LEVIN2004.limits: Observational 0-3 scale; preliminary reliability (kappa .14-.85); sample younger than typical stroke population.

LAZEM2026.citation: Lazem H, Harris D, Hall A, et al. Validity and reliability of the Track-UL algorithm compared with Kinovea software for measuring upper-limb functional range of motion in people after stroke. JMIR Rehabil Assist Technol. 2026;13:e87128.
LAZEM2026.used_for: Measurement tolerance (95% limits of agreement) and minimum detectable change for MediaPipe 2D shoulder/elbow angles in stroke; camera setup
LAZEM2026.limits: Reference was Kinovea (2D video tool), not 3D motion capture; 27 chronic stroke survivors; only 13/27 produced usable home videos.

JAYAVEL2025.citation: Jayavel P, Srinivasan HK, Karthik V, Fouly A, Devaraj A. Human upper limb kinematics using a novel algorithm in post-stroke patients. Proc Inst Mech Eng H. 2025;239(1):48-55.
JAYAVEL2025.used_for: Agreement of MediaPipe (BlazePose + BlazeHand) with a goniometer for elbow, wrist and shoulder rotation; wrist angle landmark choice
JAYAVEL2025.limits: 10 patients; Results text swaps some bias values vs Table 1 (Table 1 used here).

GILL2020_via_FMA2026.citation: Gill TK, Shanahan EM, Tucker GR, et al. Shoulder range of movement in the general population. BMC Musculoskelet Disord. 2020;21:676 - cited in FMA2026 item 16.
GILL2020_via_FMA2026.used_for: Active shoulder flexion ~160 deg in community-living non-disabled adults (secondary citation; original not reviewed)
GILL2020_via_FMA2026.limits: Only the single statement quoted in the FMA manual is used.

landmarks.pose_side_convention: MediaPipe Pose left/right = the person's own side; verify hand 'handedness' label during calibration because it depends on whether frames are mirrored

shoulder_elevation.view: sagittal for flexion, frontal for abduction
shoulder_elevation.matches: LAZEM2026 shoulder angle (hip-shoulder-elbow, 2D dot product); approximates GATES2016 humeral elevation

elbow_flexion.view: sagittal (or view where the forearm moves in image plane)
elbow_flexion.matches: LAZEM2026 elbow angle; JAYAVEL2025 elbow flexion; SOUCIE2011/GATES2016 clinical convention

wrist_extension.formula: signed angle(forearm = pose elbow->pose wrist, hand = hand[0]->hand[9]); sign fixed at calibration so dorsal extension is positive
wrist_extension.space: 2D pixel coords, side view of forearm

finger_flexion.zero: straight joint = 0 (unsigned: hyperextension cannot be distinguished)

fingertip_to_palm.matches: operationalises FMA2026 item 24 'fingertips touching the palm' (threshold proposed)

pinch_gap.matches: operationalises FMA2026 item 28 pad-to-pad opposition (threshold proposed)

trunk_flexion.formula: angle between (hip_mid -> shoulder_mid) and image vertical; report change from start frame
trunk_flexion.matches: compensation check (FMA2026 no trunk compensation; GATES2016 healthy ADL trunk motion mostly < 10 deg)

trunk_lateral_lean.formula: same as trunk_flexion in frontal view
trunk_lateral_lean.matches: FMA2026 item 15 bans lateral trunk compensation

shoulder_girdle_elevation.formula: ((ear_y - shoulder_y)_start - (ear_y - shoulder_y)_now) / shoulder_width; positive = shoulder hikes toward ear
shoulder_girdle_elevation.matches: FMA2026 item 15 bans shoulder girdle elevation; LEVIN2004 'excessive scapular elevation'

upper_arm_in_plane_ratio.formula: len2D(shoulder->elbow) / len2D(shoulder->elbow at start with arm at side)
upper_arm_in_plane_ratio.matches: proposed foreshortening check for 'without abduction' (FMA13/16) or 'without flexion' (FMA15); ratio cos(30 deg)=0.87 means ~30 deg out of camera plane

trunk_share_of_reach.formula: forward displacement of shoulder_mid / forward displacement of wrist, from reach start to grasp
trunk_share_of_reach.matches: LEVIN2004 trunk displacement component (share of hand displacement done by the trunk)

nose_touch_error.formula: dist(hand index_tip, pose nose) / dist(pose left_eye, pose right_eye)

signal_processing.pixel_scaling: multiply normalised x by frame width and y by frame height before any 2D angle (else angles distort with aspect ratio)

low_pass.source: GATES2016 used a 4th-order low-pass Butterworth at 6 Hz on marker data; use a causal equivalent (e.g., 2nd-order Butterworth or One Euro) in real time

signal_processing.plausibility: reject angles above SOUCIE2011 group max + tolerance as tracking errors

abduction.shoulder.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
abduction.shoulder.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

forward_elevation.elbow.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
forward_elevation.elbow.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

forward_elevation.shoulder.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
forward_elevation.shoulder.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

hand_to_head.elbow.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
hand_to_head.elbow.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

hand_to_head.shoulder.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
hand_to_head.shoulder.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

hand_to_mouth.elbow.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
hand_to_mouth.elbow.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

hand_to_mouth.shoulder.tolerance_rule: max(5 deg goniometer inter-rater floor [SOUCIE2011], worst |95% LoA| affected side lab+home rounded up to 0.5 [LAZEM2026])
hand_to_mouth.shoulder.mdc_rule: use laboratory MDC when the guided camera setup is followed; home MDC is available as a stricter/looser alternative

wrist_flexion_extension.tolerance_rule: LoA < 2 deg vs goniometer (n=10) is below the 5 deg goniometer floor, so floor used
wrist_flexion_extension.mdc_rule: no test-retest data; use 2 x tolerance as provisional change threshold

elbow_flexion_simple.tolerance_rule: goniometer floor (single-plane elbow flexion; JAYAVEL2025 LoA -2.7 to 1.62)

finger_joints.tolerance_rule: no MediaPipe finger-angle validation in the reviewed sources; 10 deg provisional, prefer normalised metrics relative to calibration

trunk.rule: trunk change > 10 deg from start = compensation cue; GATES2016 found most healthy ADLs used < 10 deg trunk/pelvis motion; 5 deg floor as above
trunk.note: derived use of a descriptive finding, not a published cut-off

position.rule: Standard position: sitting on a chair without armrests; alternative position (armchair, wheelchair) allowed if documented; assessor decides if correct scoring is possible, else 'not testable' = 0
position.engine: log seat_type per session; flag scores from non-standard seat

demo.rule: Each movement explained and demonstrated by the assessor sitting in front; physical guidance to demonstrate is allowed
demo.engine: play demo clip + one spoken instruction before first rep

repetitions.rule: Keep repetitions low (1-3); score best performance if it varies
repetitions.engine: assessment mode: 3 attempts, item score = best attempt

non_affected_first.rule: Movement can be performed with the non-affected arm first to check understanding and for comparison
non_affected_first.engine: calibrate right (unaffected) side first; store as personal reference

no_assistance.rule: In general no assistance for active movements of tested body parts (item-specific exceptions listed)
no_assistance.engine: supervisor check-in cannot help the tested limb; log assistance flag

no_compensation.rule: Compensatory movements with other body parts (e.g., trunk) are not allowed
no_compensation.engine: any compensation flag caps rep_score at 1

uncertainty.rule: A lower score should be selected if uncertainty exists between levels
uncertainty.engine: if peak within tolerance band of threshold -> choose lower score for the logged FMA-style score

non_affected_reference.rule: Non-affected arm performance can be used as reference when it is unimpaired
non_affected_reference.engine: targets for items using 'non-affected side' criteria = right-side calibration

passive_rom_first.rule: Test passive ROM before scoring items that require full active range

contracture.rule: If passive ROM limited by contracture > 1/4 of normal range, item max score is 1 or 0 and reason noted
contracture.engine: if therapist marks contracture > 25% of normative range: cap rep_score at 1

elbow_deficit.rule: Elbow extension deficit up to 30 deg from contracture (not spasticity) counts as maximum available range; >= 30 deg -> item not testable (score 0)
elbow_deficit.engine: elbow_extension_target = max(0, therapist_contracture_deficit) if deficit < 30 else mark item not_testable

not_testable.rule: Movement not performable due to pain, apraxia etc. -> not testable, scored 0 with reason
not_testable.engine: allow therapist to disable item; never show 'fail' to user

spasticity.rule: If spasticity present, use slow stretch to test passive ROM

01.start_position: sitting, hand in lap, forearm supinated

03.score_2: Retraction >= end position on non-affected side
03.signals_to_measure: shoulder landmark depth (z) vs non-affected side; unreliable in 2D
03.start_position: hand outside opposite knee, elbow 0, forearm pronated

04.score_2: Elevation >= end position on non-affected side
04.signals_to_measure: shoulder-to-ear vertical distance vs non-affected side (frontal view)

05.score_2: Shoulder abduction to 90 deg (>= 90, not necessarily max)

06.score_2: Full external rotation with hand touching the ear

07.score_2: Full elbow flexion with hand touching the ear
07.key_numeric_criteria: hand touches ear (almost full active movement)

08.signals_to_measure: palm normal from hand landmarks (0,5,17) relative to forearm

09.score_2: Across midline enough to reach end position (opposite knee)
09.signals_to_measure: wrist crosses body midline and reaches contralateral knee zone
09.start_position: hand near ipsilateral ear, shoulder abd 90, elbow flexed, supinated

10.signals_to_measure: elbow flexion angle -> 0 (within available passive range)

11.score_2: Pronation enough for palm outside contralateral knee
11.signals_to_measure: palm normal orientation at end position
11.key_numeric_criteria: palm on lateral side of opposite knee

12.score_0: Hand does not pass ASIS or only via gravity tricks/compensation
12.score_1: Past ASIS without compensation, end position not reached
12.score_2: Dorsal hand touches lumbar spine, MCPs past spinous processes, no trunk compensation
12.start_position: sitting on chair edge, hand in lap

13.score_0: No flexion OR cannot obtain/maintain start with extended elbow (elbow flexion and/or abduction immediately)
13.score_1: Partial OR elbow flexion and/or abduction before 90 deg
13.score_2: Pure shoulder flexion to 90 deg without abduction, full elbow extension maintained
13.signals_to_measure: shoulder elevation angle (sagittal view), elbow flexion angle, plane-of-elevation / out-of-plane check
13.key_numeric_criteria: 90 deg; elbow 0 (contracture deficit up to 30 deg = max available; >=30 deg -> not testable)
13.start_position: arm at side, elbow 0, forearm neutral, palm to body, wrist neutral

14.score_0: No movement OR cannot hold start OR one direction only
14.score_1: Not full range but stable OR loses start position before full range
14.score_2: Full pronation and supination with maintained elbow and shoulder positions
14.signals_to_measure: palm normal rotation range; elbow angle stays ~90; shoulder stays neutral

15.score_0: No abduction OR cannot obtain/maintain start with extended elbow
15.score_1: Partial OR elbow flexion and/or forearm supination before 90 deg
15.score_2: Pure abduction to 90 deg with elbow extension and forearm position maintained
15.signals_to_measure: shoulder abduction angle (frontal view), elbow flexion angle, trunk lateral lean, shoulder girdle elevation
15.start_position: arm at side, elbow 0, forearm neutral, palm to body
15.not_allowed_or_notes: lateral trunk compensation, shoulder girdle elevation

16.score_0: No flexion beyond 90 OR cannot obtain/maintain start with extended elbow
16.score_1: Partial OR elbow flexion/abduction before full flexion
16.score_2: Full pure shoulder flexion with full elbow extension, no abduction
16.signals_to_measure: shoulder elevation angle 90->max (sagittal view), elbow flexion angle, out-of-plane check
16.key_numeric_criteria: full = max available ROM; manual cites ~160 deg active flexion in community non-disabled adults (Gill 2020)
16.start_position: shoulder 90, elbow 0, forearm neutral, thumb up

17.score_0: No movement OR cannot hold start OR one direction only
17.score_1: Not full range but stable OR loses start before full range
17.score_2: Full pronation and supination with maintained elbow and shoulder positions
17.signals_to_measure: palm normal rotation range with elbow ~0 and shoulder ~30 flexion
17.key_numeric_criteria: full range vs non-affected side; carrying angle 5-15 deg is normal

18.score_0: 2+ reflexes markedly hyperactive OR <6 in part IV

19.item_name: Wrist stability 15 deg dorsal extension, elbow 90
19.score_1: Reaches 15 deg but cannot hold against resistance
19.signals_to_measure: wrist extension angle = forearm (pose elbow->wrist) vs hand (hand 0->9)
19.key_numeric_criteria: 15 deg dorsal extension (assessed visually in manual)
19.not_allowed_or_notes: elbow/shoulder may be supported by assessor

20.score_0: No movement OR one direction only
20.score_1: Not full range but both directions OR only one cycle
20.score_2: At least two full-range extension/flexion cycles
20.signals_to_measure: wrist flex/ext angle time series; cycle count; range vs non-affected side

21.item_name: Wrist stability 15 deg dorsal extension, elbow 0
21.score_1: Reaches 15 deg but cannot hold against resistance
21.score_2: Holds 15 deg against resistance (>= non-affected arm)

22.score_0: No movement OR one direction only
22.score_1: Not full range but both directions OR only one cycle

23.signals_to_measure: hand landmark 9 trajectory around wrist: circularity + smoothness (jerk)

24.score_1: Less than full fist OR not all fingers OR thumb inside fist
24.score_2: Full flexion of all 5 fingers, fingertips touch palm, thumb outside fist
24.signals_to_measure: fingertip(8,12,16,20)-to-palm distance / palm size; thumb tip position outside fingers
24.start_position: shoulder neutral, elbow ~90, fingers fully extended

25.signals_to_measure: MCP/PIP/DIP flexion angles all fingers; thumb extension
25.start_position: shoulder neutral, elbow ~90, fingers fully flexed (fist)

26.score_1: Achieves hook position, cannot hold against resistance
26.signals_to_measure: MCP 2-5 ~0 deg while PIP and DIP flexed

27.score_0: Cannot perform pure adduction with extended joints
27.score_1: Pure adduction holding paper against gravity
27.signals_to_measure: thumb tip(4) to index MCP(5) distance with all joints extended, thumb in hand plane
27.key_numeric_criteria: thumb meets index MCP, joints 0 deg

28.score_0: Cannot open fingers to grasp / hold pencil between pads
28.score_1: Grasps and holds pencil, not against tug
28.signals_to_measure: thumb tip(4)-index tip(8) distance; pads opposed; digits 3-5 not supporting
28.start_position: shoulder neutral, elbow ~90, hand ready to grasp

29.score_1: Grasps can (palm contact, thumb opposed), not against tug
29.signals_to_measure: hand pre-shape opening then closure around ~5 cm can; object occludes landmarks

30.score_1: Grasps ball (palm contact, thumb opposed), not against pull
30.signals_to_measure: hand pre-shape opening + thumb opposition around tennis ball

31.score_0: Marked tremor OR cannot complete 5 reps
31.signals_to_measure: index tip (hand 8) path deviation from straight line; high-frequency jitter
31.start_position: sitting upright, hand on ipsilateral knee, eyes closed
31.not_allowed_or_notes: head or trunk movement to compensate

32.score_1: Slight but systematic, close to nose tip
32.score_2: Index tip lands on nose tip all 5 reps (first rep may deviate slightly)
32.signals_to_measure: index tip (hand 8) to nose (pose 0) distance at each touch, normalised by face size

33.score_0: Affected >= 6 s slower OR cannot complete 5
33.signals_to_measure: time from hand leaving knee to hand back on knee after 5 reps, both arms, non-affected first

layer1_fma.note: Webcam output is an 'FMA-style' score for coaching and progress logs; items needing resistance are capped at 1; reflex and hand-to-lumbar items are not measurable.

use: plausibility check: measured angle > group max + tolerance => probable tracking error

active_shoulder_flexion_reference_deg.note: active flexion ~160 deg across age groups in non-disabled adults

wrist_extension.note: reported as -33 (extension negative); stored positive = extension

elbow flexion.notes: all tasks required >= 81 deg elbow flexion

trunk lateral lean (ROM).notes: majority of tasks required little to no trunk or pelvis motion (<10 deg)

trunk flexion-extension (ROM).notes: box off ground; 50 deg for donning pants

open_hand_pre_grasp_targets_deg.meaning: hand must open to at least this (flexion <= value) to pre-shape for 90% of Sollerman ADL tasks

closed_hand_grasp_targets_deg.meaning: fingers must flex to at least this to grasp in 90% of tasks

general.rule: Compensatory movements with other body parts (e.g., trunk) are not allowed when scoring

trunk_flexion_or_lean.cue: Keep your back against the chair.

arm_leaves_movement_plane.cue_flexion: Lift straight in front of you.

close_target.score3_note: 'no or almost no' trunk displacement; 0.10 proposed

calibration_protocol.detail: camera 1.5 m from chair, lens ~90 cm high, perpendicular to the movement plane; sleeveless/light clothing; even lighting
chair without armrests is FMA standard; an armchair may be used for safety if logged
3 recorded reps right side, then 3 left side
~10 s between reps, ~1 min between tasks
best of 3 (FMA best performance) and mean of 3 (for change detection) per metric and side
optional passive ROM / contracture entries cap targets; elbow deficit < 30 deg = max available; >= 30 deg = item not testable

reference_values.symmetry_index: affected / unaffected (Soucie: healthy left-right differences < 1 deg)

target_ladder.formula: target_k = min(ceiling, affected_baseline + k * step); ceiling = min(unaffected_max, therapist_passive_limit, normative_ceiling)

step_deg.why: a step smaller than measurement tolerance cannot be detected reliably

target_ladder.named_milestones: insert FMA thresholds (e.g., 90 deg) and GATES2016/BAIN2015 task values that lie between baseline and ceiling; announce when crossed

progression_rules.origin: project Think-module defaults (Eleanor Extended Program doc), not from the reviewed papers

rules.if: clean success >= 80% in 2 sessions in a row, pain not higher, compensation not rising
success < 50% OR compensation in most reps

modes.assessment: 1-3 attempts per item, best attempt counts, weekly (frequency proposed)
modes.training: sets of reps with coaching feedback

rep_fma_style_score: 0: movement from start < tolerance, OR start position cannot be obtained where the item requires it
1: moved, but peak < FMA threshold, OR |peak - threshold| <= tolerance (uncertain => lower score, FMA2026), OR form rule broken before threshold, OR any compensation flag
2: peak > threshold + tolerance (outside the uncertainty band), all form rules held, no compensation
scoring.rep_coaching_success: peak >= personal_target - tolerance AND form rules held; compensation => success_with_cue (counts, but logged and slows progression)
scoring.progress_claim_rule: say 'you improved' only if session value (best of 3) minus reference >= MDC for that task/joint; otherwise praise effort/consistency

feedback_map.2: specific praise naming the gain or the life goal
feedback_map.1: one cue about the failed form rule, or 'a little higher'
feedback_map.tracking_lost: blame the system: 'I can't see your arm, move into the box'

scoring.elbow_start_allowance: start elbow flexion must be <= max(tolerance(elbow), therapist contracture deficit < 30 deg) (FMA2026: full extension of available passive range at start)

shoulder_flexion_raise.name: Arm raise to the front (FMA 13 then 16)
shoulder_flexion_raise.camera_view: sagittal (chair side-on, affected arm nearest camera)

form_rules.cue: Lift straight in front of you.

shoulder_abduction_raise.name: Arm raise to the side (FMA 15; FMA 05 in synergy)

hand_to_mouth.name: Cup to mouth (Gates drinking task; Lazem task 4)
hand_to_mouth.safety: Empty cup only until swallowing advice allows food/drink to mouth.

hand_to_head.name: Hand to head / ear (FMA 07 hand touching ear; Lazem task 3)

elbow_extension.name: Straighten the elbow (FMA 10)
elbow_extension.contracture_rule: FMA2026: deficit up to 30 deg from contracture = max available; >= 30 deg = not testable

wrist_extension.name: Wrist up (FMA 19/21 then 20/22)
wrist_extension.camera_view: side view of forearm, elbow ~90 deg (19/20) or ~0 deg (21/22)

hand_open_close.name: Bloom: open and close the hand (FMA 25 then 24)
hand_open_close.all_fingers_rule: FMA2026: score 2 needs all 5 fingers; any finger short => 1
hand_open_close.normalised_metric: hand_aperture as % of right-hand calibrated range
hand_open_close.life_goal_link: Opening your hand to hold the watering can.

pinch.name: Bubble pinch (FMA 28 position)
pinch.rule: digits 3-5 must not support the pinch (their tips stay away from thumb tip)

tabletop_reach.name: Light the lamps: reach to near and far targets (RPS)
tabletop_reach.camera_view: 45 deg between frontal and sagittal on affected side
tabletop_reach.setup: seat 42 cm, backrest, no armrests; table 72 cm; chair at arm's length (wrist crease at 4 cm mark); feet flat; not leaning on backrest
tabletop_reach.life_goal_link: Reaching for the salt on the table.

finger_to_nose_timed.name: Finger to nose x5, both arms timed (FMA 31-33)
finger_to_nose_timed.adaptation: Eyes open for Eleanor (MCI, fall risk) => results NOT comparable to clinical FMA 31-33; log as 'adapted'.
finger_to_nose_timed.timing: start when wrist leaves knee zone; stop when wrist returns to knee zone after 5th touch
